about: John's model tiers for Anchor code jobs (2026-10-13). Anchor and stewards only READ this file; John changes it. 'standard' is the dashboard's setting (latest model, highest effort). A job started with --size small runs its family's 'small' entry; a family missing here runs standard. Claude models are the CLI aliases sonnet, opus or haiku; ChatGPT and Gemini models must be in their own model lists.
